description: This file defines the Catalyst controller for managing 'Dish' entities within the Coocook project. It includes actions for viewing, editing, creating, deleting, and repositioning dishes and their ingredients, as well as handling AJAX requests for these operations.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Dish
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing dish-related actions in the Coocook application.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Sets up the dish object in the stash by retrieving it based on the provided ID, used as a chained base for other actions.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Handles the display of the dish editing page, preparing JSON data and related entities for rendering.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a dish and redirects to the project edit page.

methods.name: delete_ajax
methods.description: Deletes a dish via AJAX and returns a success JSON response.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new dish related to a meal, based on submitted JSON data, via AJAX.

methods.name: from_recipe
methods.description: Creates a dish from a recipe, based on submitted data, via AJAX.

methods.name: recalculate
methods.description: Recalculates dish ingredients based on servings and redirects to the ingredients section.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an ingredient to a dish.

methods.name: update_ajax
methods.description: Updates dish details and tags via AJAX, returning JSON.

methods.name: reposition
methods.description: Repositions an ingredient within a dish (move up or down).
